subject: SEO
label: LOCAL SEO BASICS
caption:
Your website's main job is helping local customers find you. If you make these three quick fixes—updating your homepage title, listing specific cities, and typing your address in plain text—you will instantly make your business more visible on Google.

#localseo #smallbusinessmarketing #webdesigntips #localseotips #seo

slides.title: Is your homepage tab just named 'Home'?
slides.body: Look at your browser tab right now. If it just says 'Home' or your business name, local customers can't find you on Google. You are missing out on searches happening in your town today.

slides.title: Change your SEO title in 60 seconds.
slides.body: Swap 'Home — Smith & Sons' for 'Plumber in Austin, TX | Smith & Sons'. This instantly tells Google exactly what you do and where you do it, so you show up for local searches.

slides.title: Stop writing 'Serving the tri-state area.'
slides.body: Google's algorithm doesn't know what 'tri-state' means. Replace vague regions with actual city names like 'Portland, Beaverton, and Gresham.' If you don't name the cities, you won't rank in them.

slides.title: Is your address trapped inside an image?
slides.body: If your footer address is part of a graphic or map image, Google cannot read it. Type it out in plain text so search engines can verify your physical location and show you to nearby customers.
